copy.headline: A Round of Answers
copy.deck: A charity invitation. A familiar rival. Nothing casual about the round.
copy.body: The invitation promised a morning for a good cause. The round exposed less charitable intentions. Dr. Duckhook knew every ridge of his own course; ObiWan Jacoby had returned with a memory the host would rather forget. A clean strike earned a glance. A ball in the rough earned silence. By the time they walked toward the green, the autumn light was still beautiful. Neither rival was looking at it.

scene.emotional_spine: Hospitality becomes a personal contest; the course stays beautiful while the rivals lose their composure.
scene.ground_plan: Readable shot axis: tee/fairway runs lower-left toward upper-right. Clubhouse remains horizon-left and pond camera-right. At the final green, the flag is uphill of a visible short apron descending to the pond. Opponent stays outside every swing arc.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Dr. Duckhook rotates through a driver follow-through; both hands share one grip. ObiWan Jacoby watches the same ball from behind the tee marker, outside the swing arc.
beats.what_changes: The host stops welcoming and starts performing. The confirmed outcome is resolved in the selected finale.
beats.transition: Follow the attention, not a second identical swing.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: ObiWan Jacoby plants his boots in sand, flexes his knees and turns through one recovery stroke. Ball, club and sand fan remain separate; Dr. Duckhook watches beyond the safe arc.
beats.what_changes: The visitor must solve a different physical problem rather than simply copy the host.
beats.transition: Move from the stroke to the rival whose expression changes.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: The spectator golfer stops smiling and tightens a hand around the club; the scorecard folds shut without displaying invented numbers.
beats.transition: Page turn replaces noisy action with the quiet final-green wide.

scene.page_turn_out: The smiles have gone; what does the last hole put at risk?
